To pay the penalty for (something); to atone for, to make amends.

examples.text: Foole-hardy Knight, full soone thou shalt aby / This fond reproach, thy body will I hang, [Hee takes down / his pole.] / And loe vpon that string thy teeth shall hang: Prepare thy selfe, for dead soone shalt thou bee

glosses: To pay (something) as a penalty, to atone for; to suffer (something).

examples.text: Who dyes the vtmoſt dolor doth abye, / But who that liues, is lefte to waile his loſſe: / So life is loſſe, and death felicity.

glosses: To endure or tolerate (something); to experience.

examples.text: The muckle black deil was father to the Frasers, a'body kens that; and as for the Gregara, I never could abye the reek of them since I could stotter on two feet.

glosses: To pay the penalty; to atone.
